sentences.en: Wilma's Mum took the children to an adventure playground.

They all wanted a go on the zip wire.

sentences.en: "Yee-haw!
This is scary," called Chip.

sentences.en: Then the wind blew and it began to rain.
sentences.zh: 然后这风 blew 和它开始到雨。

sentences.en: We can come back another day."

sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to a cliff near the sea.
sentences.zh: 它把他们带到了城堡。

sentences.en: A bad storm was blowing.
sentences.zh: 一个坏的暴风雨是吹。 向下这小路。

sentences.en: Suddenly there was a bank.
sentences.zh: 突然，钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: A bright light lit up the sky.
sentences.zh: 一个鲜艳的轻的 lit 向上这天空。

sentences.en: Then a girl ran down the path.
sentences.zh: 然后一个女孩跑海。

sentences.en: Behind her was a man on crutches.
sentences.zh: 在……后面她是一个男人在……上腋杖。

sentences.en: "Will you help us?" Asked the girl.
sentences.zh: “你们能帮帮忙吗？” 国王问道。

sentences.en: "The storm has blown a ship onto the rocks.
sentences.zh: 这暴风雨有 blown 一个轮船在……上到将你帮助我们？ 问这女孩。

sentences.en: The light in the sky was a call for help."
sentences.zh: 这轻的在……里这天空是一个必须到叫这救生艇。 叫为了帮助。

sentences.en: "We can't help," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们不能帮助， 说 Wilma。 Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: "You need to call the lifeboat." "We can't," said the girl.
sentences.zh: 他们跑到这救生艇火车站。 “我看不见了！”

sentences.en: "The lifeboat has gone to help another ship."
sentences.zh: 这救生艇有去了到帮助另一个轮船。

sentences.en: "We can't," said the girl.
sentences.zh: 我们不能， 说这女孩。

sentences.en: "I'm Jane's father," Said the man.
sentences.zh: “我才是这里的巨人！” 那人说道。

sentences.en: "I should be out with the lifeboat, but I've hurt my back."
sentences.zh: 如果你应该是出和……一起这救生艇， 但是帮助我们， 我们能解救他们。

sentences.en: "My name is Jane," said the girl.
sentences.zh: 我的名字是 Jane， 说这女孩。

sentences.en: "The ship is stuck on the rocks," Said Jane.
sentences.zh: 这轮船是 stuck 在……上这岩石， 说我是 Jane's 爸爸， 说这男人。 娜丁说道。

sentences.en: "People are in danger.
sentences.zh: 人们是在……里单个儿。

sentences.en: If you help us, we can rescue them."
sentences.zh: 如果你应该是出和……一起这救生艇， 但是帮助我们， 我们能解救他们。

sentences.en: They ran to the lifeboat station.
sentences.zh: 他们跑到这救生艇火车站。

sentences.zh: 这 Jane 装载东西在……上到一个驴。 波浪是锵锵作响在……上方这轮船。

sentences.zh: 她给这孩子们长的波兰人这个是一个坏的暴风雨， 说 Wilf。 到搬运。

sentences.en: They went back along the path.

sentences.zh: 这 Jane 装载东西在……上到一个驴。 波浪是锵锵作响在……上方这轮船。

sentences.en: "This is a bad storm," Said Wilf.

sentences.zh: Jane 告诉这孩子们到睫毛二 Jane's 爸爸有一个特别的大炮。

sentences.en: "We must make sure they don't fall over," She said.
sentences.zh: 我们必须做确信的他们不飞穿过这空气和拥有大量土地的在……上射击一个线出在……上方这水。 她说。

sentences.en: Jane's father had a special cannon.
sentences.zh: Jane 告诉这孩子们到睫毛二 Jane's 爸爸有一个特别的大炮。

sentences.en: He shot a line out over the water.
sentences.zh: 他们在水下看到了一艘船。

sentences.en: The line flew through the air and landed on the ship.
sentences.zh: 这线落下在……上方， 她说。 这轮船。

sentences.en: Jane tied a rope to the line.
sentences.zh: Jane 租给雇工的一个绳索到这线。

sentences.en: People on the ship pulled it across.
sentences.zh: 这然后他们租给雇工的这绳索到这轮船。 人们在……上这轮船拉它穿过。

sentences.en: The Then they tied the rope to the ship.
sentences.zh: 这然后他们租给雇工的这绳索到这轮船。 人们在……上这轮船拉它穿过。

sentences.en: Jane's father put a pulley on the rope.
sentences.zh: Jane's 爸爸放一个滑车在……上这绳索。

sentences.en: The pulley had a ring tied to it.
sentences.zh: 这滑车有一个戒指租给雇工的到它。

sentences.en: "I get it," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我得到它， 说 Wilf。 Wilf 说道。

sentences.en: "The people sit in that funny-looking ring." Said Jane.
sentences.zh: 这人们坐在……里那个 funny-looking 戒指。 娜丁说道。

sentences.en: "And I thought the zip wire was scary," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我想这拉链金属丝是穿过在……上这滑车。 Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: It was hard pulling the people across on the pulley.
sentences.zh: 它是困难的拉这人们可怕的， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "Now we pull them in," said Jane.
sentences.zh: 现在我们拉他们在……里， 说 Jane。

sentences.en: The rope dipped in the middle and it swung in the wind.
sentences.zh: 这绳索浸在……里这中间和它 swung 在……里这风。

sentences.en: The last to come was the captain.
sentences.zh: 这最后的到来是这船长。

sentences.en: "I've lost my ship, but you've saved our lives," He said.
sentences.zh: 我已经丢失我的轮船， 但是你已经谢谢你为了帮助我们， 她说。 挽救我们的住， 他说。

sentences.en: "Thank you."
sentences.zh: “谢谢你。”

sentences.en: Jane looked at the children.
sentences.zh: Jane 看在这孩子们。

sentences.en: "Thank you for helping us," She said.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你所做的一切。” 她说。

sentences.en: Then the key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这时，钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: "I'm glad I wasn't on that ship," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: Gran 不是在楼下。 Wilma 说道。

sentences.en: "The zip wire at the playground won't seem scary now."
"Not even in a storm?"
